title: Google Maps Business Scraper
description: Search Google Maps by keyword and location. Each business is saved with its name, address, phone, category, rating, website, opening hours, reviews, and photo links.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: What to look up on Google Maps. Put a business type and a place on each line, for example "coffee shop in Austin, TX". Each line is searched separately.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: How many businesses to save for each search. The run stops at this number even when Google has more results.

includeReviews.title: Include reviews
includeReviews.description: Save review text for each business. Turn this off to skip reviews and finish faster.

maxReviewsPerPlace.title: Max reviews per place
maxReviewsPerPlace.description: How many reviews to keep for each business. This run stores a short set of review snippets, not a business's full review history. Set this to 0 to save no review text.

requestDelaySecs.title: Delay between requests
requestDelaySecs.description: Seconds to wait between requests to Google. The default is enough for a normal run. Increase it if requests start getting blocked.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Leave this off to connect directly. Turn on Apify Proxy to start with datacenter proxies. If Google blocks a request, that request is retried through a residential proxy.
